name: ekumetrics-platform
description: Ekumetrics Platform — plano de control, portal e ingesta del agente

scripts.platform:services: docker compose --env-file infrastructure/docker/.env -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres nats prometheus loki tempo alertmanager grafana otel-collector keycloak node-exporter alloy
scripts.platform:iam: docker compose --env-file infrastructure/docker/.env -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d keycloak
scripts.platform:ai: docker compose --env-file infrastructure/docker/.env -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml --profile ai up -d
scripts.preflight:test: node --test scripts/preflight.test.mjs scripts/install.test.mjs scripts/backup.test.mjs scripts/restore.test.mjs scripts/diagnostics.test.mjs scripts/release-check.test.mjs scripts/upgrade.test.mjs scripts/asvs-check.test.mjs scripts/zap-report-check.test.mjs scripts/rag-evaluate.test.mjs && sh apps/platform-api/load-secrets.spec.sh
scripts.compose:check: docker compose --env-file infrastructure/docker/.env.example -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml config --quiet && npm run platform:prod:config
scripts.verify: npm run preflight:test && npm run release:check && npm run asvs:check && npm --prefix apps/platform-api run lint && npm --prefix apps/platform-api test -- --runInBand && npm run api:build && npm --prefix apps/portal-web run format:check && npm --prefix apps/portal-web test -- --watch=false && npm run portal:build && npm run compose:check
